tui.spectrum.theory_text: Leakage: a finite window smears a tone over neighbouring bins. Hann's main lobe is 4 bins wide, its side lobes stay below −31 dB. Δt·Δf ≥ 1/4π: a long window sees the tone, a short one the hit in time. Zero padding makes the grid denser but does not raise the resolution.
tui.spectrum.too_short: The window N = {n} is longer than the signal ({frames} samples): lower N with W
tui.processing.snr_note: SNR is relative to the noise-free reference
tui.processing.bayes_note: Bayes λⱼ = σ² / σₓ,ⱼ per band
tui.processing.empty: Open a WAV on tab «1 Signal» or with o
tui.processing.coeffs_chip: band scale: up to 4λⱼ · drag — λ ×
tui.processing.signal_chip: grey — noise-free reference · a / b / x
tui.processing.theory_text: Sparsity: a signal has few large coefficients, noise is an even layer of small ones in every band. soft: c − λ·sign c when |c| ≥ λ; hard: c when |c| ≥ λ, else 0. Different band gains break alias cancellation: A(ω) ≠ 0.
tui.processing.cancelled: Cancelled — press r to compute again
